values.note: Kalamazoo County: Markin Glen camping $39 a night, $5 non-refundable reservation fee per site. The camping fee includes the entrance fee for one vehicle; additional vehicles pay the $5 daily entrance or buy the $30 annual pass. Read 2026-10-22.

fees.source: https://www.kalcounty.gov/Facilities/Facility/Details/Markin-Glen-Park-2 ('Camping per night: $39', 'Reservation Fee: $5', 'The camping fees include the entrance fee for one vehicle') + https://www.kalcounty.gov/Faq.aspx?TID=75 ('there is a $5 per site fee'), read 2026-10-22 in a browser (Cloudflare refuses plain HTTP)

values.note: 2026 dates: 'Markin Glen Campground will open on April 17, 2026'; both county campgrounds close November 1.

season.source: https://www.kalcounty.gov/1221/Camping ('2026 Camping Season Dates: Markin Glen Campground will open on April 17, 2026 ... Both campgrounds close for the season on November 1, 2026'), read 2026-10-22

hookups.source: https://www.kalcounty.gov/Facilities/Facility/Details/Markin-Glen-Park-2 ('38 Modern Sites, 50 amp Electric, Water and Sewer Hook Ups'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Reserve by phone with the Parks Office, 269-383-8778, Monday-Friday 8 am-4:30 pm, full payment by card. Reservations open the first business day of January for the current year only. After 14 nights campers must leave for two nights before returning. One camping unit per site.

booking.source: https://www.kalcounty.gov/1221/Camping ('All campsites require advance reservations; walk-ins are not accepted', 'Call the Parks Office at 269-383-8778') + https://www.kalcounty.gov/Faq.aspx?TID=75 ('Minimum stay: Two nights for weekend reservations. Maximum stay: Fourteen nights. Campers must leave for two nights before returning.', 'Reservations are accepted only for the current year'), read 2026-10-22

note: Kalamazoo County Parks campground in Kalamazoo on the former Morris Markin estate; concrete pads, 50-ft camper area (ADA sites 22 & 32). Swimming beach on-site. --Claude
summary: County pages confirm $39/night + $5 reservation fee (entry for one vehicle included), 38 sites with 50 A/water/sewer, showers, phone-only advance reservations, no walk-ins; added 2026 season Apr 17 - Nov 1, a two-night weekend minimum and 14-night maximum. Dump station not mentioned on the county pages (left). Note trimmed of booking, price, season and hookup text.
